title: Cell type-independent profiling of interactions between intracellular pathogens and the human phosphoproteome
authors: Mohler K; Moen J; Rogulina S; Rinehart J
one_liner_zh: 该文开发细菌展示平台筛选病原体蛋白与磷酸化人类蛋白的互作，虽涉及PPI但对象非IDP/相分离，且方法为实验筛选而非AI/物理模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Interactions between proteins from intracellular pathogens and host proteins in an infected cell are often mediated by post-translational modifications encoded in the host proteome. Identifying protein modifications, such as phosphorylation, that dictate these interactions remains a defining challenge in unraveling the molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis. We have developed a platform in engineered bacteria that displays over 110,000 phosphorylated human proteins coupled to a fluorescent reporter system capable of identifying the host-pathogen interactome of phosphoproteins (H-PIP). This resource broadly enables cell-type independent interrogation and discovery of proteins from intracellular pathogens capable of binding phosphorylated human proteins. As an example of the H-PIP platform, we generated a unique, high-resolution SARS-CoV-2 interaction network which expanded our knowledge of viral protein function and identified understudied areas of host pathology.
abstract_zh: 细胞内病原体蛋白与感染细胞中宿主蛋白之间的相互作用，通常由宿主蛋白质组中编码的翻译后修饰介导。识别决定这些相互作用的蛋白修饰（如磷酸化）仍是揭示发病分子机制的关键挑战。我们开发了一个工程菌平台，展示超过110,000种磷酸化人类蛋白，并耦合荧光报告系统，能够识别宿主-病原体磷酸化蛋白相互作用组（H-PIP）。该资源广泛支持细胞类型无关的交互查询和发现，适用于能够结合磷酸化人类蛋白的细胞内病原体蛋白。作为H-PIP平台的一个示例，我们生成了一个独特的高分辨率SARS-CoV-2相互作用网络，扩展了我们对病毒蛋白功能的认识，并识别了宿主病理中尚未充分研究的领域。
